thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: Burnout: I can't switch off after work and my mind keeps racing at night
thread_summary: Look for a dev describing racing thoughts at night, overwork, or poor sleep after long days.
text: A few things that help many people: a fixed shutdown time with a short written list of tomorrow's tasks, so your head stops holding them, and 10 minutes of slow breathing or a walk before bed. Keep the last coffee before 2 PM, since caffeine has a half-life of around 5 hours. If this has been going on for months or comes with low mood, talking to a doctor or therapist is worth it, and a supplement isn't a substitute.
why: Racing mind at night is our core Nights audience. Advice is behavioural and safe.
